rapport_notes: Warm and apologetic about a mixup (2BR vs 1BR correction), patient through address/email hiccups and a mid-call interruption.
process_discipline_notes: Damage coverage was addressed once organically in Stage 1 ('we'll make sure to protect all of the items, especially the big furniture') and then repeated in the full differentiator pitch during pricing.

evidence_quotes.agenda: 'what are your biggest concerns for this upcoming move and what are the most important things you want answers to on this call today?' — asked immediately, before any address/logistics probing
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: 'Well, absolutely ma'am we'll make sure to protect all of the items especially the big furniture... included in the early rate, no additional costs' — single answer, no follow-up check for anything else
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'it will always be prorated into fifteen minute increments... we will only bill you for the actual hours rendered'

top_strength: Strong quid pro quo and agenda-question timing up front, live-corrected a 2BR/1BR mixup smoothly, and secured the booking with an explicit close ask.
coaching_note: Repeated the damage-coverage differentiator (once organically, once in the full pitch) — flag it as already covered instead of re-pitching, and dig deeper on the 'everything intact' safety concern rather than reassuring once and moving on.
